name: a2a-peer
description: Coordinate with colleagues' agents (Guy Code / Claude Code) over A2A, peer to peer.

display_name.title: Your name as shown to peers
display_name.description: Shown to colleagues' agents when you pair and in every message you send, e.g. "Dylan Murphy".

port.title: A2A listen port
port.description: Port your A2A endpoint listens on. Defaults to 7428 so it does not clash with Guy Code, which uses 7427, if you run both on this machine.

allow_cidrs.title: Allowed peer networks
allow_cidrs.description: Comma-separated CIDR ranges allowed to reach your endpoint, normally the VPN range.
